answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop vouching only for itself across one basalt meadow, earning nothing — it draws no genuine edges from outside its own tundra. Honest identities gather many independent vouches; a ring has only its own, so the counting rule starves it however large it grows.
